text:
ravi: quick sync: ran comparative eval for new 7B-q4 models with speculative decoding + reranker in the loop. want to share surprising bits before the writeup.
nora: nice. what datasets?
liam: main matrices: small-smoke (100 prompts), long-doc (2k tokens), and conv-rag holdout (1k queries + retrieved chunks). reranker is our default tfidf+cross-encoder.
benchbot: run summary: model=new-ember-7b-q4, speculative=true, spec_aggressiveness=0.5, rerank=true
benchbot: perf: median_lat=98ms (no spec baseline 145ms), p95=410ms (baseline 480ms), tok/s=240 (baseline 170), mem=13.0GB
benchbot: quality: smoke-correct=96.3% (baseline 96.9%), halluc_flags +2.0% relative, reranker-accuracy @top1 +0.8% (reranker rescued some spec errors)
eva: interesting that reranker improves top1 despite small correctness dip on smoke. suggests spec generates diverse candidates, some of which are better but ranker selection matters.
ora: can you break down where reranker helped vs hurt?
benchbot: artifact: s3://redwood-test-artifacts/spec-rerank/6187654321/breakdown.csv
benchbot: quick numbers: of 1000 conv-rag queries, spec-only top1 worse in 28 cases vs baseline, but reranker corrected 19 of those, leaving net -9. reranker introduced 6 regressions where it picked a lower-quality candidate.
liam: sounds like tuning the reranker threshold could recover net wins. also maybe increase candidate beam size when spec is on so reranker has better options.
ravi: did we test quant variants? ql8/ql4?
benchbot: ql8 similar perf uplift and slightly lower mem. ql4 had ~10% more halluc flags on conv-rag and occasionally worse reranker rescues (likely due to noisier logits).
eva: what about sampling stability? KL on smoke vs baseline: q4=0.013, q8=0.020. spec increases KL by ~0.002 on average.
liam: holdout ablation: disabled reranker and increased beam from 4->8: correctness recovered most losses but latency jumped ~25% p95. tradeoff.
nora: operationally, whats the risk if we ship with reranker+spec? rollback triggers?
opsbot: suggested canary: 5% traffic, monitor correctness abs_drop >0.8% OR reranker-regressed-rate >1% OR latency_p95 > 1.2x baseline -> auto rollback.
ravi: action items: (1) liam tweak candidate beam and rerank threshold to target net positive of +0.5% correctness, (2) benchbot run q4/ql8 matrix overnight with conv-rag heavy queries, (3) add reranker-selection telemetry (sampled) for canary.
eva: add a mini-eval that measures "reranker harm" specifically so we don't hide systemic bias.
liam: will do. I'll also add a small experiment to use the reranker score difference as a confidence filter: only use reranker when delta>0.1.
botch: thanks team. I'll post the csv and a short slide summary in #eng-ml-docs once overnight finishes.
ravi: thanks all. nice path forward — aim to decide on canary config tomorrow AM. :rocket:
